links.outcome: PEMAT-P understandability and Flesch-Kincaid readability of chatbot prostate cancer information
links.effect: Pooled PEMAT-P understandability median 91.7% (83.3-91.7%); Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease median 50.4 (49.2-52.5), indicating moderate complexity.
links.quote: Readability analysis demonstrated moderate complexity, with a pooled median (IQR) Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease score of 50.4 (49.2-52.5) and a median word count of 666 (657-1022).

links.outcome: Quality of chatbot prostate cancer information using DISCERN
links.effect: Pooled median DISCERN 56.5 (53.0-61.0), moderate quality; limitations in evidence transparency; ChatGPT 5.2 and Copilot higher, Claude and Perplexity lower.
links.quote: Overall information quality was moderate, with a pooled median (interquartile range [IQR]) DISCERN score of 56.5 (53.0-61.0).

unlisted_practices: Comparative evaluation of patient-directed cancer information across public chatbots using DISCERN and PEMAT-P
Integrating actionable decision-support tools into chatbot responses

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of commercial LLM chatbots generating prostate cancer information evaluated using DISCERN, PEMAT-P, and readability formulas without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
